facts.business: Repro India Limited operates a technology-driven platform connecting publisher content to readers, enabling on-demand printing and distribution of books with zero upfront investment, zero inventory, and zero forecasting for publishers.

segments.name: E-commerce / Technology Platform for Book Publishing

capacity_or_capex.item: Technology development (intangible assets and intangible assets under development)

auditor.name: M S K A & Associates LLP

key_risks: Cyclical demand and pricing in principal markets
Changes in Government regulations and Tax regimes
Economic developments in India and countries where the Company operates
facts.related_party_note: Amount due to related parties out of trade payables was ₹320 lakhs as at March 31, 2026 (₹188 lakhs as at March 31, 2025). Repro Books Limited recorded revenue from operations of ₹30,603 lakhs during FY2025-26.
